session_note: Cloud-agent session on branch cursor/semaev-2015-audit-program-5b8b, 2026-09-13, on user instruction to add a Nagao pursuit. Fetched because Nagao 2015/984 -- the paper whose Theorem 1 this program is costing and whose Proposition 5 it is testing -- cites this one as [11] for Lemma 3 and declines to prove it there ('Proof of this Lemma is complicated and not constructive'). Lemma 3 is what licenses using the FAKE first fall degree d'_F in place of the true d_F, and d'_F is the only one of the two a degree-4 Macaulay rank can compute, so the instrument EXP-SEMBIN-4fa22c builds rests on it. IDEA-20260913-352163 listed this paper under `unread_pointers` and said plainly that nothing there bears weight. This retrieval is what allows a later record to cite it at all.

attempts.purpose: Freeze the full text of the paper that proves Lemma 3 and Lemma 5 of Nagao 2015/984 -- the first-fall-degree machinery over Weil-descended systems, and the license for substituting the fake first fall degree for the true one
attempts.reason: Vendored under the paper's CC BY licence, so the copy in the repository is the copy that was read.

derived_artifacts.extractor_note: Identical extractor and parameters to inputs/NAGAO-2015-984/ and inputs/SEMAEV-2015-310/, so a textual difference between the three means a difference between the papers.
derived_artifacts.extraction_quality: POOR RELATIVE TO THE 2015 PAPER, and disclosed rather than repaired: the draft typesets vectors as overset arrows, which pdfminer emits as separate lines, so the displayed formulas of Sections 2-3 interleave with accent fragments. The text is a searchable index of the paper; any formula that carries weight must be read in the PDF, whose hash is pinned beside it.
known_extraction_artifacts: overset vector arrows emitted as standalone lines, splitting formulas
fi/ff/fl ligatures preserved as the PDF encodes them
superscripts and summation limits flattened onto the baseline

what_this_provenance_does_not_assert: That Lemma 3 is correct, that its proof is present in this text, or that the version frozen here is the version Nagao 2015/984 cited. It records only that these bytes are the bytes eprint.iacr.org served at the recorded time and that the text file is a mechanical extraction of them. Whether the lemma the 2015 paper leans on is actually proved here is the reading task, and its answer belongs in a knowledge record, not in this file.
